canonical.name: The exhaustion-band regrouping that compresses countably many coordinate blocks to finitely many Euclidean blocks plus one proper coordinate
A proper injective immersion is an embedding because local embeddedness plus proper closedness upgrades the corestriction to a homeomorphism onto its image
The secant-direction and unit-tangent-direction maps are isolated as explicit geometric bad-direction carriers for projection arguments
Nearest-point projection agrees with the tubular retraction after shrinking the tube appropriately
Positive continuous error functions are promoted to a first-class approximation datum because uniform epsilon control is not honest on arbitrary noncompact manifolds
The smooth and continuous homotopy categories of smooth manifolds have the same morphism sets once maps and homotopies are both smoothed
A transverse perturbation of a section yields a zero submanifold of the expected codimension by combining transverse approximation with the zero-set criterion for sections
